name: oli-indexer-ops
description: Orchestrate, trace, review, and safely conclude approved OLI Indexer jobs through explicit technical and human gates.

interface.shortDescription: Orchestrate and review indexing jobs safely.
interface.longDescription: Navigate OLI Indexer data, trace runtime configuration, execute exact jobs from the local oli-indexador checkout with its .env, and review extraction, indexing inputs, final analyses, human-approved Conclusion, and post-reaper reconciliation. Six automatically discovered skills cover ordinary work; explicit-only skills preserve narrow authority without replacing human approval.
defaultPrompt: Audit an extraction before indexing starts.
Review indexing inputs before analyses run.
Orchestrate a job through its technical gates and final pre-approval.
